title: eludite.solution.select_configuration input
description: Choose in the Standard toolbar's Solution Configurations or Solution Platforms list, or a multi-targeted project's Target Framework list: the selection is kept per solution (per user, beside the startup project) and Build, Debug and Test use it (a Cargo workspace builds `--release` for Release). A project the selection does not map to a build is skipped on build with Visual Studio's `Skipped Build` Output line.

configuration.description: A solution configuration the solution lists.

platform.description: A solution platform the solution lists.

framework.description: The target framework F5 and Run Tests use for `project` (one of its frameworks).

project.description: With `framework`: the multi-targeted project (name or path). Default: the startup project.
